name: @djgrant/freeagent/loans-and-liabilities
description: Reads and normalizes director loans and FreeAgent short/long-term liability nominal accounts.

needs_auth.hint: Sign in to your FreeAgent account, then retry.

reads: FreeAgent account loans and liability balances

resolve.post: ($rows := $.{'code': $match(href, /show_transactions\/[^/]+\/([^?]+)/).groups[0], 'account': $trim($substringAfter(label, ' ')), 'debit': $money(debit), 'credit': $money(credit), 'transactions_url': href}; {'liabilities': [$map($filter($rows, function($a) { $a.code in ['650','794','795','796','797','798','799','813'] or $contains($a.code, '907-') }), function($a) { {'code': $a.code, 'account': $a.account, 'classification': $contains($a.code, '907-') ? 'director_loan' : ($a.code = '650' ? 'provision' : ($a.code = '796' ? 'trade_creditor' : ($a.code = '797' ? 'other_creditor' : ($a.code = '813' ? 'pension_creditor' : ($a.code in ['798','799'] ? 'hire_purchase_liability' : 'other_liability'))))), 'term': $a.code in ['794','798'] ? 'short_term' : ($a.code in ['795','799'] ? 'long_term' : 'unspecified'), 'debit': $a.debit, 'credit': $a.credit, 'liability_balance': ($a.credit ? $a.credit : 0) - ($a.debit ? $a.debit : 0), 'transactions_url': $a.transactions_url} })]} )
